question: Who is the author of the book "Win The Battle of Your Mind: Scroll Less, Read More"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reeta Ramamurthy Gupta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Reeta Ramamurthy Gupta’s book "Win The Battle of Your Mind: Scroll Less, Read More" was launched at Crossword Juhu, Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reeta Ramamurthy Gupta is the author of the book "Win The Battle of Your Mind: Scroll Less, Read More".**
 
• The book was launched at Crossword Juhu, Mumbai in the presence of eminent personalities.
 
• The book emphasizes cultivating mindfulness and building reading habits in the digital era.
 
• It serves as a practical guide for behavioral change and personal transformation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Dr. Niranjan Hiranandani__

 __
 
• Praised the book for its message promoting mindfulness and the value of reading in modern life.
 
 
 
• Behavioral Transformation__
 __
 
• The process of changing behavior patterns to achieve personal or professional goals.
 
 
 
• Mindfulness__
 __
 
• A mental state achieved by focusing awareness on the present moment, often used to reduce stress.
 
 
 
• Reading Habit__
 
 
• Regular practice of reading which enhances cognitive development and critical thinking skills.
